templates.why_chosen: Star, 25-component exemplar: inside the purple Hydro Coordinator band, a Cluster Scheduler core sits flanked left by two allocator boxes and right by an Elastic Executor, a flanked-core micro-pattern nested inside a layered whole.
templates.what_to_learn: A flanked-core sandwich can appear at any scale: repeat the same left-core-right composition inside one band of a larger layered figure, colour that band and its neighbour differently, and orange-highlight the technique sub-boxes inside each; the weakness here is the central box's role is legible only from position, so add one line to it.
